article.from:
A merchant pushing $50,000 from a PayPal balance to bank pays $25, which works out to 0.05 percent effective. The same push on Stripe Instant Payouts at 1.5 percent would cost $750. The same push on Square Instant Transfer at 1.75 percent would cost $875.

The 1.75 percent fee with a $25 cap makes PayPal the cheapest instant option in this comparison for any single push above roughly $1,450. Below that threshold, Stripe Instant Payouts at 1.5 percent come out cheaper.
article.to:
Pushing $20,000 instantly costs $300 from a PayPal balance at 1.5 percent, $300 on Stripe Instant Payouts at 1.5 percent and $390 on Square Instant Transfer at 1.95 percent.

PayPal's instant fee matches Stripe's at 1.5 percent with the same 50 cent minimum, and both undercut Square's 1.95 percent.
